title: bauhinia integrifolia subsp. cumingiana
intro: Bauhinia integrifolia subsp. cumingiana, commonly known as Philippine orchid tree, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Bauhinia integrifolia subsp. cumingiana include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties.
